title: The Rivers and the Sea
summary: The freshwater rivers assembled to complain against the Sea: "Why do you turn our sweet, pure waters into bitter brine the moment we flow into your depths?"...
full_text:
The freshwater rivers assembled to complain against the Sea: "Why do you turn our sweet, pure waters into bitter brine the moment we flow into your depths?"

The majestic Sea replied: "If you wish to remain sweet, stop flowing into my bosom! You seek my embrace freely, and then complain of the nature of the ocean!"
moral: Do not blame the ocean for transforming the sweet streams that seek its depths.
